description.zh: 需要作为学习样本的文章集合
description.en: A collection of articles to use as learning samples.

description.zh:
* 代表处理阶段
     * "full": 生成特点分析和创作内容
     * "analysisStage": 仅生成特点分析
     * "creationStage": 仅生成创作内容
description.en:
- Specifies the processing stage.

  - "full": Generates both a style feature analysis and the final content.

  - "analysisStage": Generates only the style feature analysis.

  - "creationStage": Generates only the final content.

description.zh: 大模型生成功能的内容素材模型集合
description.en: A collection of reference materials for the large model's content generation.

description.zh: 文体特征标识符。如果指定了此参数，接口会按照指定的文体特征进行写作
description.en: The style feature identifier. When specified, the API generates content based on this feature.

description.zh: 是否自动检索互联网补充素材
description.en: Specifies whether to automatically search the internet for additional reference materials.

description.zh: 用户输入的写作主题，可以对主题进行自定义调整效果
description.en: The theme for the generated content. Providing a custom theme helps fine-tune the output.

title.zh: 传媒/零售文章风格与格式学习
title.en: Media/Retail Article Style and Format Learning
